title: Security Program Manager
description:
About the Team

OpenAI builds powerful AI systems like ChatGPT, the OpenAI API, and enterprise products that serve millions of users across the globe. As we scale, securing our infrastructure, protecting sensitive data, supporting employees’ velocity, and meeting global compliance standards are essential to our success and societal impact.

Security at OpenAI is a cross-cutting organization that includes Security, Privacy, IT, GRC, Corporate Security, and other teams. Program Managers play a critical role in aligning teams and delivering execution at scale.

About the Role

We’re seeking a Program Manager to build and own programs that span OpenAI’s Security organization, with a core focus on Mergers & Acquisitions. You will work across domains from diligence through Day 1 readiness, integration, onboarding, and transition to ongoing ownership. You will also apply what you build to other priorities that span Security teams. You will learn how work actually moves between teams, spot gaps and unclear ownership, and build practical systems that make complex transitions easier to execute.

This role is deeply cross-functional and execution-focused. It requires a structured operator who thrives in ambiguity, partners effectively across boundaries, and applies principled judgment to drive programs at speed from initial planning through durable handoff. You will use AI and automation to reduce repetitive work and help teams operate at greater scale, while applying sound judgment to sensitive information and consequential decisions.

In this role, you will:

- Own Security & IT M&A programs, including supporting System Operations and other engineering teams in defining and performing timely diligence assessments, and scoping, planning, and executing acquisition integrations. Carry the work through Day 1 readiness, onboarding of people and systems, post-close priorities, and handoff to ongoing owners.

- Partner with Corporate Development, IT, Infrastructure, Application, Legal, Privacy, Security, GRC, Corporate Security and other teams to understand cross-functional requirements and navigate tradeoffs. Make responsibilities and decision rights clear while bringing in the right experts for technical and risk judgments.

- Learn partner teams’ workflows and identify missed dependencies, bottlenecks, duplicated effort, and risks that could slow an integration or weaken its outcome. Address recurring problems at their source.

- Establish scalable frameworks and processes to support core programs, including defining durable program goals and core measures of success. Build useful intake paths, playbooks, onboarding checklists, decision points, and handoff standards that teams adopt in practice.

- Use AI and automation to organize information, surface gaps, improve documentation, route work, and track follow-through, with appropriate handling of sensitive information and human review of risk decisions.

- Create and maintain program-level visibility across deals, risks, milestones, and dependencies, ensuring program outcomes are delivered reliably and at high quality. Measure whether the work improves readiness, reduces manual effort, closes risks, and makes future transitions more predictable.

- Communicate status, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions clearly to technical and executive audiences and drive cross-functional execution with urgency and care.

- Own additional programs that span Security and IT as organizational priorities evolve, applying and improving the systems built through the M&A portfolio.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Are an empathetic communicator and leader who is able to influence a variety of cross-functional and executive audiences, and build durable trust with partners.

- Have 5+ years of experience leading complex cross-functional programs, with a proven record of successful partnership in security, IT, infrastructure, privacy, trust, product risk, or other technical domains.

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

We are looking for a Senior Business Development Manager to join our team. This is a Hybrid (Santa Clara, CA, 3 days per week) role, reporting to the Director of Technology Alliances. As a key member of our global Sales and Go-to-Market organization, you will build and scale strategic technology partnerships across Data Protection and Email Security use cases. In this role, you will orchestrate joint product integrations and go-to-market strategies that accelerate customer adoption and solidify Zscaler's position as the world leader in cloud security.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Own developing a strong ecosystem of partners to address Data Protection and Email Security use cases, orchestrating new differentiated integrations that drive unique value for joint customers and source or influence new engagements

• Work with Product and Solution Architecture teams to identify product integration opportunities that address new customer use cases and build business cases to prioritize them

• Understand partners’ business objectives, go-to-market approach, and channel mechanisms to build and execute partnership strategies focused on new sales and customer engagements

• Identify key decision makers and influencers at partner organizations, find areas for highest impact new business to both parties, and drive execution across sales, marketing, and product functions

• Influence key senior, mid-level, and line-level relationships to gain preference for Zscaler

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You act like an owner with a strong bias for action, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on partnership execution.

• You are customer-obsessed, anchoring ecosystem strategy and integration efforts in solving real-world security challenges.

• You are a high-trust collaborator who builds deep relationships across sales, marketing, product, and partner teams.

• You are data-driven, leveraging clear metrics and analytics to measure partnership impact, track KPIs, and guide strategic decisions.

• You champion simplicity by distilling complex technical concepts and multi-party alignment into clear, actionable plans.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or an MBA if undergraduate degree is non-technical

• 5+ years of demonstrated experience in strategic business development, technology alliances, product management/marketing, or technical sales enablement at a Software or SaaS technology provider with a mix of start-up and public company experience preferred

title: Healthcare Insurance Specialist
description:
Job Overview:
As a Remote Healthcare Insurance Specialist, you will be responsible for the management and administration of health insurance policies, communicating with customers and health care providers to ensure that policies are understood and implemented correctly. Additionally, you are to provide guidance to customers by answering questions and addressing concerns about their policies.
Ideal Candidate:
The ideal candidate will possess strong communication and organizational skills, and the ability to work independently and effectively within a virtual environment.
Key Responsibilities:

• Assist customers with selecting health insurance policies based on individual needs and budget

• Provide expert advice and guidance to clients regarding health insurance policies, benefits, limitations and coverage.

• Answer client inquiries and resolve issues in a timely and professional manner.

• Explain complex insurance information in a clear and understandable way

• Assist clients with enrollment, changes, and other insurance-related tasks.

• Verify insurance eligibility and benefits for clients.

• Process and track insurance claims accurately and efficiently.

• Resolve claim denials and appeals.

• Maintain accurate records of client interactions and transactions.

• Stay up-to-date on changes to health insurance laws, policies, and regulations

• Maintain in-depth knowledge of various health insurance plans and their coverage.

• Identify and address potential issues with coverage and benefits.

• Demonstrate strong communication skills, both written and verbal, in a virtual environment.

• Maintain a professional and organized workspace.

• Utilize technology effectively to manage workload and communicate with clients and colleagues.

• Assist with special projects and tasks as assigned.

• Contribute to a positive and collaborative team environment.

Skills and Qualifications:
Educational Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare, or a related field.
• Completion of courses in insurance or health insurance.
• Strong understanding of HIPAA regulations to ensure the secure handling of personal health information and compliance with privacy laws.
Desired Skills:

• Experience with insurance portals and payer systems, such as Availity or other provider-specific platforms, for verifying eligibility, checking claim status, and processing insurance-related transactions efficiently.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

• Strong organizational and problem-solving skills.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and other relevant software.

• Ability to work independently and manage time effectively.

• Knowledge of health insurance plans and regulations

• Ability to adapt to changes in policies and regulations.

• Experience with claims processing and verification.

• Ability to explain complex policies and procedures to customers.

• Attention to detail and accuracy in record-keeping and data entry

title: Senior Project Manager - Dynamics ERP Implementation

The role is accountable for successful client outcomes, predictable execution, financial control, and alignment to business value using Hitachi Solutions ’ delivery methodology. This role is intended for an experienced consulting PM who can quickly stabilize delivery, lead with transparency, and operate as a trusted client and internal governance lead.
The Senior Project Manager will serve as a project delivery leader, bringing together cross-functional talent from delivery, architecture, functional, technical, offshore, PMO, and client teams. In this role, you are expected to establish ownership, maintain disciplined plans and forecasts, use KPIs to drive proactive action, escalate early, manage scope and change through process, and demonstrate commercial judgement in decisions that affect margin, risk, and client outcomes.
Duties and Responsibilities
As a Senior Project Manager, you will be responsible for:

• Contributing to PMO and Delivery Excellence process improvement by capturing lessons learned, improving reusable delivery practices, and adopting standard tools, templates, and reporting discipline.

• Providing first-line project escalation support to the team, establishing accountability, coaching delivery behaviors, resolving conflicts, and helping address capability or execution gaps.

• Leading teams through ambiguity while maintaining delivery control, driving timely decisions, balancing competing priorities, and reinforcing execution discipline under pressure.

• Proven project management experience implementing ERP, CRM, Dynamics 365, Azure, and/or broader cloud solutions in a client-facing consulting environment.

• Proven experience managing multi-platform, multi-workstream projects across onshore, offshore, client, and delivery teams.

title: Senior Security Engineer, Offensive Security
description:
ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

As a Senior Security Engineer, Offensive Security, you'll help drive offensive security at Docker, putting our products, platforms, and cloud infrastructure under realistic adversarial testing to surface and drive out attack paths before real adversaries find them. You'll partner with engineering, product, and leadership to turn findings into durable fixes and to shape how security is designed into every Docker product.

You'll apply your expertise in penetration testing, threat modeling, and exploit development to find and eliminate risks across Docker products and infrastructure. Working across cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), containerized environments, and AI/ML products, you'll implement proactive security solutions that scale with Docker's growth.

This role offers the opportunity to help improve security programs at a company whose products are trusted by millions of developers worldwide. You'll work in a fast-paced, technically challenging environment where your security expertise directly impacts both Docker's platform and the broader container ecosystem.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Contribute to security initiatives that align with business goals, helping ensure security is a core component of our products and infrastructure

- Support and help implement key security programs such as automated security design reviews, and vulnerability management

- Build deep knowledge of software security and architecture, and act as a go-to resource for engineering teams

- Partner with engineering to design and implement security architecture and controls across Docker products and platforms

- Plan, scope, and execute penetration tests and red-team / adversary-emulation engagements against Docker's products and services

- Develop proof-of-concept exploits and produce clear, risk-rated findings with actionable remediation guidance, then retest fixes to confirm closure

- Build and maintain offensive security tooling and automation to expand testing coverage and repeatability

- Perform security reviews and threat modeling (design, architecture, and code) across Docker products and services, including emerging AI products, and write automated security tests and exploits

- Serve on rotating on-call schedule to respond to security events, investigate threats, and coordinate remediation efforts

- Educate and collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., engineering, product) to promote security practices

- Participate in Security Incident response

QUALIFICATIONS

- Have 3+ years in security engineering, including hands-on offensive security and penetration testing across applications and infrastructure

- Possess 2+ years of hands-on development experience in Python or Golang

- Demonstrate deep expertise in authentication, authorization, including technologies like OAuth, cryptography applications and Zero Trust principles.

- Have strong hands-on experience with securing cloud ecosystems (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure)

- Have hands-on penetration testing experience across SaaS web applications and APIs., including manual exploitation beyond automated scanners

- Are proficient with offensive tooling and techniques such as. Burp Suite, and OWASP frameworks

title: Performance Ad Creator | 100% Remote
description:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/b540b9e2-0673-4d2d-91fd-e293658f4f6a/b7561393-0797-4849-9149-363b09bab85c/job%20ad%20visual.png]

Please be informed that Foxelli Group hires exclusively in-house and doesn't work with any external recruitment agencies. Any company or individual claiming to recruit on behalf of Foxelli Group is not affiliated with us.

Foxelli brings together curious people who enjoy building brands, exploring AI and making ideas happen. Our D2C brands reach millions of customers and generate more than $20M a year. Behind them is a team that cares about the products we make and enjoys figuring things out together.

We like people who ask questions, try things and take responsibility for what happens next. If that sounds like how you work, keep reading.

WHY JOIN FOXELLI

You’ll create for our own e-commerce brands. Your ideas can go from a rough concept to a live ad, with real customer response to help you improve the next one.
We make room for experimentation and expect you to bring ideas to the table. AI is part of how we work, and we’re interested in how you use it to make better creative, learn faster and simplify production.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Performance Ad Creator who can take a product, understand why someone would want it and turn that insight into a video ad that sells.
You’ll own the idea as well as the execution: find the angle, write the hook and script, choose how to tell the story and produce the finished ad. You’ll work with our creative lead and media buyers to learn from results and decide what to create next.

If you enjoy:

- Looking through customer reviews and spotting a reason to buy that others have missed.

- Figuring out why an opening makes you stop scrolling, then creating your own.

- Writing copy that sounds like a real person and gives the viewer a clear reason to care.

- Experimenting with footage, AI and different ways to tell a product story.

- Seeing how your ads perform and coming back with a better idea.

We’d love to work with someone who brings that curiosity all the way through to a finished ad.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

Customer research and creative concepts

- Get to know our products and customers. Read reviews, explore objections and study existing creative to find promising angles.

- Develop original ad concepts for paid social, especially Meta. Choose a clear selling idea and a format that suits the audience.

Copywriting and production

- Write hooks, scripts, on-screen copy and calls to action in English.

- Produce complete ads using product footage, creator content and AI-generated assets. Own the edit, voiceover, captions, sound and pacing.

- Use AI throughout your workflow where it improves the result. Check that the product stays accurate and the visuals and voice feel believable.

Testing and improvement

- Create different openings and concept variations to test new messages, motivations and storytelling approaches.

- Review results with media buyers and use what you learn to improve existing ads and develop new concepts.

- Review your own work before submitting it, apply feedback thoughtfully and communicate clearly about progress and deadlines.

WHAT YOU BRING

title: Software Engineer, Grok Connectors
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Engineer on the Grok Connectors team at SpaceXAI, you'll build the integrations that let Grok, Cursor and Grok Bot do real work inside the tools people use every day: Gmail, Outlook, Google Calendar and Drive, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive and SharePoint, GitHub, Slack, finance accounts, and a fast-growing marketplace of third-party MCP plugins. You'll architect, implement, and deploy features end to end, from OAuth sign-in and token handling, to tool schemas and reliability across hundreds of millions of tool calls, to the cards and approval flows users see on web, desktop, and mobile. You'll work directly with enterprise customers and partners to ship connectors that large organizations can trust.

YOU MAY BE A FIT IF

- You have an entrepreneurial spirit and love creating outsized business impact.

- You want AI agents to be genuinely useful, by connecting them to real data and real actions safely.

- You have deep, practical knowledge of OAuth 2.0 and OIDC and of large provider APIs like Google Workspace and Microsoft Graph, or you're excited to become the expert.

- You care about reliability: concurrency, retries, rate limits, and observability. You fix root causes, not symptoms.

- You let data decide what to work on. You size user impact from logs and metrics, and you measure error rates before and after every fix.

- You're strong in TypeScript and comfortable shipping across backend services and client UI in a large codebase.

- You enjoy working with customers, partners, QA, and support, and can answer a security review question as clearly as you can fix a bug.

- Bonus: experience with the MCP protocol, Rust, Kubernetes and multi-cloud deployments, enterprise security and compliance (ZDR, audit logs, Conditional Access), or building LLM agents for automation.

SAMPLE PROJECTS INCLUDE

- Building an automated triage system that pulls user reports from feedback channels, groups them by root cause with user-impact estimates, files issues, and starts a first-pass coding agent on each fix

- Redesigning OAuth token refresh so concurrent requests never burn a single-use refresh token and mark a working connector as disconnected

- Cutting hundreds of thousands of daily tool-call errors by generating tool definitions from vendors' published API specs, fixing argument mapping, and adding batch tools

- Shipping Gmail and Outlook draft, reply, and attachment flows, with approval cards so an agent never sends an email without the user's sign-off

- Launching new partner connectors, from debugging a partner's OAuth metadata to rollout and adoption metrics

- Making connectors work for enterprise and single-tenant deployments: custom certificate authorities, Entra Conditional Access, admin controls, and compliance reviews with large financial institutions

APPLYING

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2-3 short technicals. After, we'll schedule an onsite in our office, where you'll work on a small project, discuss ideas, and meet the team.

title: Research Engineer
description:
About us

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production. Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more.

We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

 

The role

We're looking for a Research Engineer to join Encord's ML team. You'll work on robotics, computer vision and multimodal research in data curation, annotation, evaluation and quality control, with successful work going into the core product.

We face a variety of interesting research problems across the full data life-cycle, including annotation, quality control, verification and curation. We are looking to strengthen our team to build upon and extend our market-leading platform. The kind of problems we solve are constantly evolving alongside the needs of our frontier customers, including many of the leading robotics and physical AI teams. Join us as we leverage our massive flow of proprietary data on our journey to develop generalised solutions applicable across diverse multi-modal tasks.

 

What you'll do

- Form hypotheses, design experiments, and drive original research on open problems from leading robotics and AI customers

- Research and prototype agentic workflows which can handle multimodal inputs and diverse customer ontologies

- Advance our work on data curation and model evaluation

- Tackle egocentric video understanding, from captioning to deeper 3d understanding

- Build working prototypes to test ideas end to end, then partner with our ML systems and Product Engineering teammates to bring them into the platform

- Help shape our longer-term research direction and bring the most relevant ideas from the field back to the team

- Publish research papers and present your work at conferences and workshops

 

Who we're looking for

- A builder with a research mindset. You can take an open-ended problem, form a hypothesis and get to a working prototype without a detailed spec.

- A first-principles problem solver. You lean on strong fundamentals rather than surface-level familiarity with the latest trends.

- A big-picture thinker. You're excited by ambitious, longer-term problems and know how to break them into steps.

- A multiplier. You raise the level of the team around you by shaping research direction, mentoring others and turning findings into decisions.

 

Experience requirements

- A PhD in computer vision, machine learning or a related field, or equivalent applied research experience

- A strong background in computer vision and multimodal ML, whether in traditional CV, modern VLMs and embedding models, or both

- Clear evidence of independent research, such as publications, a thesis, open-source work or applied research where you owned the original contribution

- Solid mathematical foundations in statistics, probability and linear algebra

- Strong Python and PyTorch skills, and experience running experiments end-to-end

- A genuine interest in data-centric AI: curation, evaluation and data quality

- Bonus: experience applying LLM-based agents to visual tasks, or working with video, 3D or other complex data types

 

We’ll start reviewing applications from 1 November 2026. It may take a little while to hear back, but every application will get proper consideration.

 

Why Encord

- Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth startup

- Strong in-person culture - most of the team works from our London office 4+ days/week

- 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays

- Annual learning & development budget

- Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe

- Daily company lunches

- Monthly socials & bi-annual team offsites

You will take ownership of product development strategy and execution, guiding Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) and cell-free DNA-based (cfDNA) In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) products from feasibility through FDA Premarket Approval (PMA) and post-market support. Every test represents a real person, and you will build an organization of scientific contributors and managers to deliver robust clinical tools. You will establish priorities, allocate resources, and represent development with the FDA and executive leadership, ensuring that scientific rigor and data drive all regulatory and portfolio decisions.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Set team priorities, allocate people, budget, and laboratory resources, and make or recommend go/no-go decisions to executive leadership

• Establish the analytical verification and validation strategy for the portfolio to ensure robust assays transfer seamlessly to commercial manufacturing

• Partner with clinical, medical, and biostatistics leaders to support approvable pivotal and prospective study design, statistical analysis plans, and performance claims for screening-population use in both the ECD and MCED intended-use claims

Be facile in representing the Development approach and activities in senior-level engagement with the FDA (e.g., pre-submission meetings and advisory panels, as applicable) and accountable for the analytical performance data packages supporting each submission

• Build, retain, and mentor a leadership team of directors, managers, and scientists, optimizing the organization’s budget and external vendor partnerships

• Think team by partnering directly across research, bioinformatics, biostatistics, software, clinical, regulatory, and commercial functions to deliver design-controlled IVD products in a highly cross-functional environment 

• Communicate portfolio status, risks, and tradeoffs to executive leadership and drive alignment on enterprise priorities  

• Ensure the organization operates within Natera’s QMS and all applicable guidance (ISO 13485:2016, FDA QMSR (21 CFR Part 820), ISO 14971, IEC 62304, etc), and partner with Quality to maintain audit readiness and strengthen design control practices

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Advanced degree (PhD, MD, or equivalent) in Molecular Biology, Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field

• 7+ years of experience in IVD or diagnostic device development under design controls

• 7+ years of experience directing scientific or technical organizations, with 5+ years managing senior managers or directors

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

• Deep technical expertise with complex NGS-based diagnostic assays, including assay design, analytical validation, and transfer to a commercial laboratory

The Rocket Motor Systems (RMS) team at Anduril designs and manufactures solid rocket motors and propulsion systems for the next generation of missiles and munitions. RMS runs a vertically integrated energetics operation - from propellant chemistry and mixing through case fabrication, assembly, and test. We move fast in a highly regulated, safety-critical environment, and we depend on accurate, real-time inventory to keep production lines building.

ABOUT THE JOB

The Inventory Analyst is responsible for managing and optimizing inventory levels to support production schedules while minimizing the costs of scrap, excess and obsolescence. This role will oversee the health of inventory across materials, quality, and production - including energetic and shelf-life-sensitive chemicals unique to a rocket motor environment. • Monitor MRB and quarantine aging, dormant and dead stock, and warehouse capacity utilization, and recommend disposition or consolidation.

• Validate inventory striped to the correct project and task charge codes, and flag material at risk from expired project dates.

• Build and maintain self-service dashboards and reports that give production, quality, and program teams a live view of inventory health.

title: Senior Partnership Manager
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join: 

Distribution Partnerships team’s mission is taking Airbnb out to the world; working with a range of partners to embed Airbnb in highly trusted and contextually relevant environments to meet guests where they already plan and book their travel, experiences, and services.

The team owns partnerships end to end, from initial ideation, strategy, engagement, and agreement through product launch and ongoing relationship management. Within it, the Business Development (BD) segment owns the front end of the partnership lifecycle: defining strategy, identifying and recruiting partners, structuring commercial agreements, and setting the foundation for long-term partnership success. BD works hand in hand with Partner Management, which grows, measures, and continuously improves each partnership after launch. This role owns partner management for a portfolio of live distribution partners, with approximately 70% of time on day-to-day management and strategic development of existing partners and 30% supporting the team on new partners and renewals, and is growing to become an end to end partnerships leader.

The Difference You Will Make:

We are looking for an experienced, proactive Senior Partnerships Manager to join our Distribution Partnerships team, reporting to the Director, Distribution Partnerships.  You will manage a portfolio of live distribution partners across our verticals, such as financial services, airlines and loyalty programs, and business travel platforms (the mix may change as priorities shift), and support new partner deals and renewals as you grow into the role.

You will carry each deal through launch and into long-term growth, establishing the measurement, forecasting, and feedback loops that let the wider team scale the program globally.

Our partnerships are powered by a portfolio of products that are still being built (embedded booking, points earn and pay with points, embeds, and a partner portal), so you will work closely with Product and Engineering on what partners need and what we can ship. This is a highly cross-functional, high-ambiguity individual-contributor role suited to someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, product, dealmaking, and partner development, and who can build a business from zero to one and one to ten with limited guidance. The role also includes project management and operations, often where processes are not yet defined, so we need someone scrappy and proactive who finds ways to unblock problems we have not identified yet.

• Partner management. Own the day-to-day relationship with your partners. • Partnership strategy. Contribute to and execute the BD strategy for your partner categories, within the wider distribution strategy. This is a senior individual contributor role in which most of your impact comes through the team: delegating clear ownership, coaching engineers, and clearing obstacles, while staying hands-on where it makes the biggest difference. You will work directly with the Sr. Director of Engineering on priorities, capacity, and how the team evolves, with room to grow into people leadership as the team expands.

• Own end-to-end execution of major initiatives: translate roadmap priorities into realistic plans, sequence work, and keep progress and risks visible to stakeholders

• Break initiatives into well-scoped work and delegate clear ownership across the team, so delivery doesn't depend on any one person

• Help design and build an AI-native delivery system, applying AI-assisted and agentic tooling from planning through release to increase velocity without lowering the quality bar

• Partner with senior engineers and engineering leadership to turn technical direction into concrete delivery plans, raising risks and tradeoffs early enough to inform technical decisions

• Coach and mentor senior engineers on ownership, planning, estimation, and cross-team communication, supporting their growth in partnership with the Sr. Director of Engineering

title: Marketing Analytics AI Research Contributor
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Aptura is looking for Subject Matter Experts from marketing analytics, across paid, organic or lifecycle channels, who build CAC, attribution and campaign performance analyses in Excel. You have used AI tools on your own work and been frustrated by the mistakes they make. You will turn that experience into realistic Excel tasks that test how well AI does the work of a Marketing Analyst.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Writing realistic Excel tasks drawn from your own work: extending existing models, fixing broken ones and building from a brief

- Working through each task yourself so there is a clear, correct answer

- Writing yes-or-no criteria precise enough that a grader can mark any attempt against them

NECESSARY QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years in marketing analytics, growth or performance marketing, covering paid, organic or lifecycle channels for B2B or B2C businesses

- Deep hands-on Excel: CAC payback, data cleaning and reshaping, pivot tables and chart selection

- Strong written English communication skills.

- Attention to detail, and willingness to learn concepts in AI and Evals

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

- Start Date : Immediate

- Duration: Approximately 4-6 weeks

- Payment: task-based. Experts who complete their first task within the required timeline will then be qualified to do multiple tasks for the remainder of the project.

CONTRACT AND PAYMENT TERMS

- You will be engaged as an independent contractor.

- This is a fully remote role that can be completed on your own schedule.

- Projects can be extended, shortened, or concluded early depending on needs and performance.

- Your work at Aptura will not involve access to confidential or proprietary information from any employer, client, or institution.

- Payments will be weekly following task completion.

GETTING STARTED

- Apply with your details and CV. Choose an available 30-minute group walkthrough call.

- Attend the walkthrough and create one original task from your own work. Submit the brief, the actual input workbook(s) needed to complete it. Input-file uploads are compulsory.

- Write the brief yourself. Input workbooks must also be human-built. Use real data that has been sanitised, or public data with the source named. No AI usage allowed.

- We run your task against current frontier AI models. If the models get it wrong, you then write a detailed yes-or-no rubric, and a reviewer signs off on the task with you.

- Completing onboarding does not guarantee a job offer; selection remains subject to written approval of the task proposal.

ABOUT APTURA

Aptura is an applied AI and data company working with frontier labs to train AI systems on real professional work. We do this by building high-quality evaluation and training environments that teach AI agents to produce work that can be used in daily workflows.

title: Software Engineer, AI Data - Kochi, India
description:
Mission
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
Overview
We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify 's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.
We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.
What Yo u’ ll Do:

• Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.

• Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.

• Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.

• Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have:

• A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.

• Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.

• Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.

• Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

• Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.

• Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

• A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products

• A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive

• Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity

• The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry

• Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture

• The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more

• An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio - a rapidly evolving tech domain

In this role, you will leverage your partner management and channel expertise to drive the sales and adoption of our EverPURE solutions through our Singapore partner ecosystem. You will build and strengthen relationships with key partners, understand their business priorities and customer needs, and develop joint strategies that create new opportunities and accelerate growth across Singapore. You will work closely with account executives, systems engineers, partner sales and enablement, marketing, and leadership team members to develop and grow the business with the full EverPURE portfolio of solutions.

The successful NPM will work in tandem with Regional Sales Directors, District Managers and Account Executives to successfully develop and service all partners and prospects within their respective geography/territory.

• Create Strategies and lead team efforts to maximize sell-through of EverPure products within Channel.

• Manage sales orders and provide status to partner and/or manager. 

• Communicate masterfully with partners on new product offerings and channel programs

• Work with marketing team (both internal and external) to drive programs and events to extend the relationships to new prospects.

• Keep abreast of competition, competitive issues and products. 

• Attend and participate in sales meetings, product seminars and trade shows. 

• Conduct contract negotiations & define and execute partner/distribution business plans.

• Conduct monthly/quarterly business performance reviews for distributors/CAM-Managed Partners

• Drive and execute Channel Programs creating a channel-led business contributions through deal registrations and partner-source opportunities 

What You Bring To The Team

• Demonstrated experience developing Channels in Singapore.

• BA/BA degree in business, marketing or software engineering.

• Ability to assess, plan, and actively manage a territory to achieve maximum revenue and efficiency.

• Excellent time management and communication skills.

• Desire to drive change and evangelize new technologies.

• Passion for post-sales customer success.

• Knowledge of the storage industry specifically: Fibre Channel, NFS, and Enterprise Storage architectures.

• Competitive attitude and strong work ethic with the ability to enthusiastically represent the company

We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bangalore/Mumbai office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.
WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

• Innovation : We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
